name: Saibara Shouko
source:
Occupation: Works as the DJ of "Cappuccino Break", a popular program in a local FM station in Sapporo.

[spoiler]A hidden heroine in "Kita e. ~Diamond Dust~". To unlock her scenario you need to clear the routes of the 5 normal heroines.[/spoiler]
